st-neots.hp: Bespoke kitchens, wardrobes, bedrooms and media walls for St Neots homes, designed at your house, made in our Peterborough workshop and fitted by our own team.
st-neots.big: St Neots has everything from Victorian terraces near the Market Square to brand-new streets at Loves Farm and Wintringham. Whatever the house, we make the furniture to fit the room.
kp: Many St Neots homes fall into two groups. The older terraces and cottages around the town centre and the river have alcoves, uneven walls and narrow staircases, so we build larger pieces in sections and scribe them to the walls on site.

The newer houses at Loves Farm, Wintringham and on the Eaton Socon estates usually come with a basic developer kitchen and bare bedrooms. If the new kitchen stays roughly where the old one was, on the same plumbing, the job is simpler and costs less. It’s also a good time to add fitted wardrobes or a media wall.
st-neots.dp: Our showroom and workshop are in Peterborough, about 30 miles from St Neots. As well as the town itself, we design and fit in Eaton Socon, Eaton Ford, Eynesbury, Little Paxton, Great Paxton and Buckden.
fq: Do you cover St Neots, Eaton Socon and Eynesbury?
Yes. St Neots is about 30 miles from our workshop, around 40 minutes down the A1, and we cover Eaton Socon, Eaton Ford, Eynesbury, Little Paxton and the villages nearby.
Can you replace the developer kitchen in a Loves Farm or Wintringham home?

Yes. Keeping the new kitchen roughly where the old one was, on the existing plumbing and sockets, usually keeps the cost down. If you’d like wardrobes or a media wall too, we can measure for them at the same visit.

corby.hp: Bespoke kitchens, wardrobes, bedrooms and media walls for Corby homes, designed at your house, made in our Peterborough workshop and fitted by our own team.
corby.big: Corby has grown a lot, from the new town estates of the 1950s and 60s to Priors Hall Park and Little Stanion. Wherever you live in it, we make your furniture to measure.
kp: A lot of Corby’s housing was built after it became a new town in 1950, so many homes have similar layouts: compact kitchens, box rooms and straightforward living rooms that suit a media wall. Made-to-measure furniture gets far more out of these rooms than standard sizes.

On the newer estates at Priors Hall Park, Little Stanion and Weldon, the starting point is usually a basic developer kitchen and bedrooms with no built-in storage. Those are the rooms where a better kitchen, fitted wardrobes or a media wall make the biggest difference.
corby.dp: Our showroom and workshop are in Peterborough, about 25 miles from Corby. As well as Corby itself, we design and fit in Great Oakley, Weldon, Stanion, Little Stanion, Priors Hall Park, Cottingham and Gretton.
fq: Do you cover Corby and the villages around it?
Yes. Corby is about 25 miles from our workshop, around 45 minutes via Oundle, and we cover Great Oakley, Weldon, Stanion, Little Stanion, Cottingham and Gretton.
Can you replace the kitchen in a new build at Priors Hall Park?
Yes. We plan the new kitchen around the existing plumbing and sockets where we can, which keeps the cost down.

kettering.hp: Bespoke kitchens, wardrobes, bedrooms and media walls for Kettering homes, designed at your house, made in our Peterborough workshop and fitted by our own team.
kettering.big: Kettering is a mix of Victorian terraces, 1930s semis and the new streets at Hanwood Park, and each of them needs something different from a kitchen or a wardrobe.
kp: Kettering’s Victorian and Edwardian terraces often have narrow kitchens, chimney alcoves and steep stairs. We plan for that from the start: made-to-measure units for the galley, alcove cupboards in the living room, and larger pieces built in sections so they fit up the stairs.
In Barton Seagrave and the new homes at Hanwood Park, it’s more often about upgrading a builder’s kitchen, adding wardrobes to bare bedrooms or putting a media wall in an open-plan living room.
kettering.dp: Our showroom and workshop are in Peterborough, about 30 miles from Kettering. As well as Kettering itself, we design and fit in Barton Seagrave, Burton Latimer, Rothwell, Desborough, Geddington and Broughton.
fq: Do you cover Kettering, Barton Seagrave and Burton Latimer?
Yes. Kettering is about 30 miles from our workshop, around 45 minutes on the A14 and A605, and we cover Barton Seagrave, Burton Latimer, Rothwell, Desborough and Geddington.
Can you make a narrow terrace kitchen work better?

Usually, yes. Made-to-measure units, full-height storage and a better layout make a real difference in a galley kitchen. If moving services would give you a much better kitchen, we’ll explain the trade-off at the survey.

march-whittlesey-chatteris.hp: Bespoke kitchens, wardrobes, bedrooms and media walls for homes in March, Whittlesey, Chatteris and the Fenland villages, made in our Peterborough workshop and fitted by our own team.
march-whittlesey-chatteris.big: Whittlesey is just down the A605 from our workshop, and March and Chatteris are a short drive further across the Fens. Wherever you are, we make your furniture to measure.
kp: Many homes in the old centres of March, Whittlesey and Chatteris are Victorian terraces and cottages, with narrow kitchens, chimney breasts and alcoves. We build larger pieces in sections so they get up older stairs, and scribe panels to the walls so there are no gaps.

On the newer estates on the edges of each town, the starting point is usually a basic builder’s kitchen and bedrooms with no built-in storage. A new kitchen planned around the existing plumbing, fitted wardrobes or a media wall make the biggest difference there.
march-whittlesey-chatteris.dp: Our showroom and workshop are in Peterborough, about 6 miles from Whittlesey, 15 miles from March and 25 miles from Chatteris. We also design and fit in Coates, Eastrea, Turves, Wimblington, Doddington and Manea.
fq: Do you cover March, Whittlesey and Chatteris?
Yes. Whittlesey is about 6 miles from our workshop, March about 15 and Chatteris about 25, and we cover the villages around them, including Coates, Eastrea, Wimblington, Doddington and Manea.
Can you fit furniture in an older terrace with uneven walls?
Yes. We measure carefully, build larger runs in sections so they fit up narrow stairs, and scribe panels to the walls on site so there are no gaps.

kings-lynn.hp: Bespoke kitchens, wardrobes, bedrooms and media walls for King’s Lynn homes, designed at your house, made in our Peterborough workshop and fitted by our own team.
kings-lynn.big: King’s Lynn has everything from Georgian townhouses near the Tuesday Market Place to newer homes in Gaywood and the Woottons. Whatever the house, we make the furniture to fit the room.
kp: Older houses in the centre of King’s Lynn often have high ceilings, deep alcoves and walls that are not quite straight. We measure every alcove and wall, build tall pieces to the full ceiling height and scribe them to the walls on site.

In Gaywood, South Wootton and North Wootton, many homes have a kitchen that is ready for an update and bedrooms that would benefit from fitted storage. We plan around the existing plumbing and sockets where we can, which keeps the cost down.
kings-lynn.dp: Our showroom and workshop are in Peterborough, about 36 miles from King’s Lynn. As well as the town itself, we design and fit in Gaywood, South Wootton, North Wootton, West Lynn, Terrington St Clement and the villages nearby.
fq: Do you cover King’s Lynn and the villages around it?
Yes. King’s Lynn is about 36 miles from our workshop, around 50 minutes along the A47, and we cover Gaywood, South Wootton, North Wootton, West Lynn and Terrington St Clement.
Can you fit furniture in an older house with high ceilings?
Yes. We build tall wardrobes and alcove units to the full ceiling height, in sections if the stairs are narrow, and scribe them to the walls so there are no gaps.

peterborough.hp: Designed in 3D, made to the millimetre in our Peterborough workshop and fitted by our own team.
peterborough.big: One team from first sketch to final fitting. We measure your room, design it with you in 3D, build every cabinet in our own workshop and install it ourselves.
kp: ABJ does more than supply furniture. Based right here in Peterborough at PE1 2AZ, we design, manufacture and install our own cabinetry in-house. That means truly bespoke home furniture, without the restrictions of standard high-street sizes or the delays of national retailers.

Whether you are renovating a period property in Longthorpe, building a new home in Hampton or upgrading an apartment in Bretton, our Peterborough team looks after every stage, from the initial 3D design right through to the final installation, and everything we make is covered by our 12-month guarantee.
peterborough.dp: We design, make and fit within about 80 miles of our Peterborough workshop. Our installation teams regularly serve the towns below, and the villages around them.
fq: Why choose a local Peterborough furniture maker?

Choosing a local specialist means faster surveys, quicker turnarounds and a team you can actually visit. Because we manufacture in our own PE1 workshop, there are no middlemen, no import delays and no compromises on quality.
How long does it take?
Once you sign off the design, your furniture usually takes four to six weeks to make in our workshop, then one to two weeks to fit.
